title: Väddö tungsten fragment from 1957 car stop

tellings.quote:
In 1957, two carpenters were driving
their car in the middle of the night
really because they were doing some work
on Monday. This was Sunday and suddenly
they saw this object coming from east
moving in front of the car making a
Uturn and suddenly hanging in front of
the car which was totally died.

plain: In 1957, two carpenters were driving through the night at Väddö, northeast of Stockholm in Sweden, when an object came in from the east, made a U-turn and hung in the air right in front of their car, and the car died completely. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells the case, which is remembered for a fragment of tungsten metal linked to it, as one he knows from his research, without naming a source. If it happened, it would be a close encounter that left something physical behind.
